transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, work has been an issue. I process insurance claims. I guess the main thing that pushed me to come in is... I just keep getting up from my workstation during the day. Even when I know I’m supposed to just stay put and, you know, finish my claim reviews. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
What is going on in your body or mind when you feel the need to get up from your desk?
Um... I don't know, really. I just... I just feel like I need to move. There's not really a specific thought or anything. I just get up.

{"intent": "Check for uncomfortable sensations in the legs characteristic of restless legs syndrome", "question": "Do you feel any uncomfortable sensations, like crawling or tingling in your legs, when you get that urge
No, not really. Just... normal, I guess. I don't feel anything weird like that.
Aside from the urge to move, do you have difficulty keeping your attention focused on your work?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. It's just... mostly the getting up part.
Is this urge to move noticeably worse in the evening or at night compared to the daytime?
Um... no. Not really. I guess I mostly just notice it during the day. Like, when I'm at work.
Did you have similar trouble sitting still or feeling restless back when you were in elementary school?

Um... I guess maybe a little. I mean, my teachers used to say I was smart, but... I'd lose my worksheets a lot. And they said I wouldn't listen to instructions. I always needed them to remind me to finish my work. So, yeah, I guess it's not totally new.
In your daily life now, do you frequently misplace or lose things you need, like your keys, phone, or paperwork?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean... at work, I'm kind of always hunting for things I just had. Like... a claim form, or my headset. Or sometimes a sticky note with a callback number on it. Even my access badge. I just... set them down and they're gone.
Do you find it difficult to organize your daily tasks or manage your time to get things done?

Um... yeah. I guess so. Since they gave me a bigger caseload, it's... harder. My claim folders and notes and, like, my email flags just sort of end up everywhere. I just... I have a hard time figuring out which policy review I should even do first. So... yeah.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting, tapping your hands or feet, or squirming in your seat?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like... if we have a long team meeting or a training session, I'm usually bouncing my leg or... clicking my pen. I try to sit still and look like I'm paying attention, but I just end up shifting around a lot. So... yeah.
